name: Time Engine
author: ct
description: Engine time subsystem: the in-game clock tick controller bridging SceneEventController timer pulses to RuntimeData.Time, the clock HUD widget, the 2D lighting stack (UiLightController, LampBehaviour, LightDef) installed into the kernel through LightingBridge, and the lighting.clear_map scenario action. Replaces the former Core/Settings/TimeTickController, Core/UI/Lights, Core/UI/Tool/TimeController and Core/Actions/LightingServiceImpl.
